## Aesthetic Record has helped shape the heart of my business.

The Aesthetic Record platform is powerful, but it’s the people behind it that make it truly
exceptional. Bobbie and the entire AR team have provided so much more than just EMR, POS, and
scheduling — they’ve helped shape the heart of my business. Enrolling with AR was one of the best
decisions I’ve ever made, and I’m endlessly grateful. ‘Thank you’ will never feel like enough.

[Adrian Nowitzke]

## Aesthetic Record has been a game-changer for Moksha Aesthetics.

From seamless charting and photo documentation to integrated scheduling and inventory management, it
has streamlined our workflow and enhanced the patient experience.

[Erika Barry & Hania Khorshidi]

## Aesthetic Record is by far one of the most advanced EHRs.

“We’ve been with Aesthetic Record for nearly five years, and it’s been one of the best investments
we’ve made for our practice. Aesthetic Record is by far one of the most advanced EHRs in the
aesthetic space, always pushing for improvement. Working with Bobbie and the AR team has been great,
and we look forward to continuing to grow together.”

[Michael Robertson]

## The customer service for Aesthetic Record has been exceptional.

They consistently provide prompt and helpful support to our nurse members. Their commitment to
ensuring nurses feel supported and can efficiently use the system is truly evident.

[Amanda Dalton]

## Aesthetic Record elevated our practice operations.

Its tailored design for Medspa’s has allowed us to build our entire practice around a membership
model, setting us apart from competitors. The POS and practice management features are seamless, and
the support team is exceptional—always responsive and helpful. Aesthetic Record has truly elevated
our operations and patient experience.

[Kenny Ash]

## Aesthetic Record has been an integral part of my business growth.

Spirited has been with AR for five years and has played a key role in my business growth. As a solo
practice, I’ve benefited from their consulting, EMR, POS, CRM, and LeadAR. Bobbie, my consultant,
keeps me organized, helps set goals, manages inventory, and guides important decisions, like
partnering with RepeatMD, Cherry, LeadAR, and purchasings my first laser. The value they bring makes
every dollar well spent.

[Heather Speert]

## Aesthetic Record has completely streamlined our workflow.

From charting and inventory to invoicing and communication, every part of our process is now
seamless and efficient.

[Jessica Sarkis]

## Aesthetic Record has been transformative for my practice.

Aesthetic Record has made our operations more efficient. With effortless charting, integrated
Streamlined scheduling, seamless charting, and powerful analytics all in one place. It’s not just a
software, it’s the backbone of my business operations.

[Renée Moran]

## Who We Serve

We empower solo providers to enterprise franchises with scalable solutions designed for every stage
of growth.

### Solo Providers

Solo providers count on us for easy-to-use solutions that simplify daily tasks and support steady
growth.

### Growing Medspas

Growing medspas thrive with our flexible tools designed to simplify workflows and support expansion.

### Multi-Location Clinics

We help multi-location clinics stay connected and consistent with smart, streamlined solutions built
for scale and success.

### Franchises & Enterprise

Franchises and enterprises rely on us for powerful, unified solutions that drive scalable growth.

### Integrations
### That Work With You

One connected experience that makes every part of your day more efficient and effective.

be severe and result in loss of life. You are at the highest risk if these problems are preexisting

**Spread of toxin effects. ** The effect of botulinum toxin may affect areas away from the injection
site and cause serious symptoms, including loss of strength and all-over muscle weakness, double
vision, blurred vision and drooping eyelids, hoarseness or change or loss of voice, trouble saying
words clearly, loss of bladder control, trouble breathing, and trouble swallowing.

**BOTOX® Cosmetic dosing units are not the same as, or comparable to, any other botulinum toxin
product. ** There has not been a confirmed serious case of spread of toxin effect when BOTOX®
Cosmetic has been used at the recommended dose to treat frown lines, crow’s feet lines, forehead
lines, and/or platysma bands. BOTOX® Cosmetic may cause loss of strength or general muscle weakness,
vision problems, or dizziness within hours to weeks of receiving BOTOX® Cosmetic. **If this happens,
do not drive a car, operate machinery, or do other dangerous activities. Serious and/or immediate
allergic reactions have been reported, ** including itching, rash, red itchy welts, wheezing, asthma
symptoms, or dizziness or feeling faint. Get medical help right away if you are wheezing or have
asthma symptoms, or if you become dizzy or faint

**Do not receive BOTOX® Cosmetic if you** are allergic to any of the ingredients in BOTOX® Cosmetic
(see Medication Guide for ingredients); had an allergic reaction to any other botulinum toxin
product such as Myobloc (rimabotulinumtoxinB), Dysport (abobotulinumtoxinA), Xeomin
(incobotulinumtoxinA), Jeuveau (prabotulinumtoxinA-xvfs), Daxxify (daxibotulinumtoxinA-lanm), or
Letybo (letibotulinumtoxinA-wlbg); or have a skin infection at the planned injection site. This list
may not include all available botulinum toxin products.

**Tell your doctor about all your muscle or nerve conditions, ** such as ALS or Lou Gehrig’s
disease, myasthenia gravis, or Lambert-Eaton syndrome, as you may be at increased risk of serious
side effects, including difficulty swallowing and difficulty breathing, from standard doses of
BOTOX® Cosmetic. **Tell your doctor about all your medical conditions, ** including surgery or plans
to have surgery on your face, trouble raising your eyebrows, drooping eyelids, any other abnormal

other medicines may cause serious side effects. **Do not start any new medicines until you have told

botulinum toxin such as Myobloc, Dysport, Xeomin, Jeuveau, Daxxify, or Letybo in the past (tell your

to temporarily improve the look of moderate to severe forehead lines, crow’s feet lines, frown lines
between the eyebrows, and vertical bands connecting the jaw and neck (platysma bands) in adults.

Cosmetic has been used at the recommended dose to treat frown lines, crow’s feet lines, forehead
lines, and/or platysma bands. BOTOX® Cosmetic may cause loss of strength or general muscle weakness,
vision problems, or dizziness within hours to weeks of receiving BOTOX® Cosmetic. **If this happens,
do not drive a car, operate machinery, or do other dangerous activities. Serious and/or immediate
allergic reactions have been reported, ** including itching, rash, red itchy welts, wheezing, asthma
symptoms, or dizziness or feeling faint. Get medical help right away if you are wheezing or have
asthma symptoms, or if you become dizzy or faint

**Do not receive BOTOX® Cosmetic if you** are allergic to any of the ingredients in BOTOX® Cosmetic
(see Medication Guide for ingredients); had an allergic reaction to any other botulinum toxin
product such as Myobloc (rimabotulinumtoxinB), Dysport (abobotulinumtoxinA), Xeomin
(incobotulinumtoxinA), Jeuveau (prabotulinumtoxinA-xvfs), Daxxify (daxibotulinumtoxinA-lanm), or
Letybo (letibotulinumtoxinA-wlbg); or have a skin infection at the planned injection site. This list
may not include all available botulinum toxin products.

**Tell your doctor about all your muscle or nerve conditions, ** such as ALS or Lou Gehrig’s
disease, myasthenia gravis, or Lambert-Eaton syndrome, as you may be at increased risk of serious
side effects, including difficulty swallowing and difficulty breathing, from standard doses of
BOTOX® Cosmetic. **Tell your doctor about all your medical conditions, ** including surgery or plans
to have surgery on your face, trouble raising your eyebrows, drooping eyelids, any other abnormal
facial change, are pregnant or plan to become pregnant (it is not known if BOTOX® Cosmetic can harm
your unborn baby), or are breastfeeding or plan to (it is not known if BOTOX® Cosmetic passes into
breast milk).**Tell your doctor about all the medicines you take, ** including prescription and
over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements. Using BOTOX® Cosmetic with certain
other medicines may cause serious side effects. **Do not start any new medicines until you have told
your doctor that you have received BOTOX® Cosmetic in the past. **Tell your doctor if you have
received any other botulinum toxin product in the last 4 months; have received injections of
botulinum toxin such as Myobloc, Dysport, Xeomin, Jeuveau, Daxxify, or Letybo in the past (tell your
doctor exactly which product you received); have recently received an antibiotic by injection; take
muscle relaxants; take an allergy or cold medicine; take a sleep medicine; or take aspirin-like
products or blood thinners.

**Other side effects of BOTOX® Cosmetic include** dry mouth; discomfort or pain at the injection
site; tiredness; headache; neck pain; and eye problems, including double vision, blurred vision,
decreased eyesight, drooping eyelids and eyebrows, swelling of eyelids, and dry eyes.

**Approved Uses** BOTOX® Cosmetic is a prescription medicine that is injected into muscles and used
to temporarily improve the look of moderate to severe forehead lines, crow’s feet lines, frown lines
between the eyebrows, and vertical bands connecting the jaw and neck (platysma bands) in adults.

For more information, refer to the Medication Guide or talk with your doctor.

To report a side effect, please call Allergan Aesthetics at 1-800-678-1605.

Guide][75].**

## Mommy Makeover in Paramus, NJ

Pregnancy can change the body in ways diet and exercise can’t always correct: loose skin, stretched
muscles, and shifts in breast shape. A *mommy makeover* is a customized surgical plan designed to
restore balance and definition, often combining breast surgery with abdominal contouring for a more
complete result. Dr. Breslow’s approach is focused on proportion, smooth contours, and a silhouette
that feels like you again, just more refined.

shape, symmetry, and how the results fit your frame. He’s also highly trusted for breast
reconstruction and revision surgery, often helping patients improve results from previous
procedures.

## Abdominoplasty (Tummy Tuck) in Paramus, NJ

A *tummy tuck* isn’t just about removing loose skin. It’s about restoring the foundation—tightening
the abdominal wall, refining the waistline, and creating a smoother, firmer contour. For many
patients, this is the procedure that finally makes their body feel aligned with their effort. Dr.
Breslow’s work is known for clean lines, thoughtful scar placement, and results that look polished,
not aggressive.

still looks natural, balanced, and elegant in real life, not just in photos.

## Blepharoplasty (Eyelid Surgery) in Paramus, NJ

brighter, more open appearance. It’s one of the most subtle procedures with one of the biggest

## Manufacturer of the Year Award

Candela has been honored with the prestigious Manufacturer of the Year Award at The Aesthetics
Awards, hosted by the renowned Aesthetics Journal. This award holds immense significance as it
symbolizes unparalleled achievement and innovation within the aesthetics industry. Determined
through a rigorous process blending expert evaluation and public voting, it reflects Candela’s
commitment to excellence and advancement in aesthetic technology. The company takes immense pride in
this recognition, which further affirms its dedication to providing the highest quality devices and
service to the medical and aesthetic community.

[View Product Portfolio][98]

[Vbeam Pro]

### Vbeam Pro^{®}*: The future of vascular laser treatments

Experience the power of PRO—Precise, Reliable, Optimized—Candela’s most advanced and versatile
pulsed dye laser (PDL) and Nd:YAG device. Vbeam Pro offers dual wavelengths for 45 medical
indications across a wide range of skin types, unprecedented PDL output accuracy, optimized dye
life, and a 15 mm treatment spot size for deeper penetration and faster treatments. As the only
vascular laser FDA-cleared for pediatric treatments, Vbeam Pro delivers the power of 595 nm with the
flexibility of 1064 nm* to redefine what’s possible in laser treatments.

*Available in North America only.
[More Info][99]

## Physician's Perspective

We've offered complementary treatments with the Sublative RF and Matrix Pro applicators and have
seen improvement in the patient’s skin luminosity, texture, and overall skin appearance as soon as
one-week post-treatment. The Sublative RF applicator effectively resurfaces the skin, while the
Matrix Pro applicator stimulates new collagen growth with a completely customized treatment. Patient
satisfaction has gone through the roof after receiving these complementary treatments.

Scott Gerrish, DO

Leading Expert in Regenerative Medicine and Esthetics

I have tried FOUR different microneedling pens at my practice, both cosmetic and medical. My
experiences varied; some were cheap, not FDA-cleared, had cartridges that would skip, drag or break,
were heavy, and/or were loud. The Exceed medical microneedling device is my preferred choice! It’s
ergonomic design and lightweight handpiece make it easier to handle, while the patented tilting
plate glides nicely, allowing me to reach every inch of my patients’ face without dragging. In my
opinion, it delivers optimal results with the best healing time.

Tara Delle Chiaie, MSN, FNP-BC, APRN

Owner of Delle Chiaie Cosmetic Medicine

The Matrix^{™} system and its Matrix Pro applicator take radiofrequency to a whole new level. The
versatility of the Matrix system, with its user-controlled depth and energy settings, allows the
user to easily tailor treatment depths and the number of passes to accommodate each patient’s
anatomy and comfort level. Using only topical numbing, my patients have been extremely happy with
their results and report low pain scores with minimal downtime.^{**}

Gilly Munavalli, MD, MHS, FACMS

Board-certified Dermatologist and Fellowship-trained Mohs Surgeon

I’ve had the GentleMax Pro laser system now for about ten years and we use it for a full range of
skin types and hair types. It’s a very versatile device; we also use it for vascular malformations,
even small angiomas; you can use it for telangientasias, you can use it for some forms of rosacea,
even some port wine stains.

I would recommend the GentleMax Pro laser system to my colleagues for lots of reasons, but primarily
because it’s so reliable and powerful.

E. Victor Ross, MD

Dermatologist, Scripps Clinic, San Diego, CA

The GentleMax Pro device is a very versatile laser system for hair removal and more. It has two
wavelengths, the 755 nm Alexandrite and the 1064 nm Nd:YAG. The advantage of having both wavelengths
in one system is that we can treat patients of all skin types and a broad range of hair types with
one device.

The GentleMax Pro laser system is also a great way to expand your practice. Many patients who come
in and experience hair removal with the system, then also become interested in treating other
cosmetic concerns. This is not only true for women but for men as well. We have men who come in for
treating hair on their backs and shoulders, and then realize they can benefit from other treatments
such as brown spots and rosacea, really broadening treatment opportunities.

through a rigorous process blending expert evaluation and public voting, it reflects Candela’s
commitment to excellence and advancement in aesthetic technology. The company takes immense pride in
this recognition, which further affirms its dedication to providing the highest quality devices and
service to the medical and aesthetic community.

[View Product Portfolio][98]

[Vbeam Pro]

### Vbeam Pro^{®}*: The future of vascular laser treatments

Experience the power of PRO—Precise, Reliable, Optimized—Candela’s most advanced and versatile
pulsed dye laser (PDL) and Nd:YAG device. Vbeam Pro offers dual wavelengths for 45 medical
indications across a wide range of skin types, unprecedented PDL output accuracy, optimized dye
life, and a 15 mm treatment spot size for deeper penetration and faster treatments. As the only
vascular laser FDA-cleared for pediatric treatments, Vbeam Pro delivers the power of 595 nm with the
flexibility of 1064 nm* to redefine what’s possible in laser treatments.

*Available in North America only.

opinion, it delivers optimal results with the best healing time.

## The Cartessa Difference

### Built For Your Benefit

Cartessa Aesthetics was founded to overcome the limitations of larger, traditional aesthetic
companies. Our business model is agile, smart, and transparent. We invest in ways to keep costs low
for our providers, while ensuring our quality and speed-to-market is best-in-class.

### Driven By Your Success

Our success hinges on the success of our providers. Our internal teams offer support at every stage
of business to help you unlock the most from your investment today, so you’ll have a reason to come
back tomorrow for a second, third, or even fifth device.

### Exceptional Technology

In a world of “good enough”, we scour the globe to find and build “exceptional” with the industry’s
leading manufacturers. Every device is vetted to ensure it meets our 3-point criteria – better
clinical efficacy, an improved patient experience, and achievable ROI.

# Cultivating confidence from the inside out
#  

At Damn Girl! Aesthetics and Wellness, we believe confidence, health, and longevity are deeply
connected. Our personalized aesthetic and wellness care is designed to enhance natural beauty,
support well-being, and deliver safe, refined, long-term results—so you can feel confident,
empowered, and more like yourself.

## Personalized Care. Natural Results. 

## Long-Term Confidence.

Here at Damn Girl! Aesthetics and Wellness, we know that when you feel and look good, there’s
nothing stopping you!


Nestled in the heart of San Antonio, Texas, our boutique MedSpa creates personalized aesthetic and
wellness treatments to make you feel and look revitalized, radiant and confident. As a small
practice, we take pride in providing all of our patients with undivided attention and expertise in a
safe, relaxing and comfortable environment.


Your treatment plan should be as individual as you are. From the moment you walk through our doors,
we take the time to understand your goals, your concerns, and the bigger picture of your health and
confidence.


Together, we create a personalized plan designed to support your skin, body, and wellness from the
inside out. Our goal is never to change who you are. It’s to help you look refreshed, feel
empowered, and age with confidence and strength.


[image of Kelly Powers with Damn Girl! aesthetics and wellness standing in her office ]

## A different aesthetics and wellness

## Experience

At Damn Girl! Aesthetics and Wellness, we’re redefining non-surgical care by combining advanced
aesthetic treatments with whole-person wellness support. We focus on education, safety,
natural-looking outcomes, and meaningful relationships—because we want to be more than a place you
visit for a treatment.

We want to be your trusted partner in feeling confident, supported, and well for years to come.

## Skincare & Supplements

# Cultivating confidence from the inside out
#  

At Damn Girl! Aesthetics and Wellness, we believe confidence, health, and longevity are deeply
connected. Our personalized aesthetic and wellness care is designed to enhance natural beauty,
support well-being, and deliver safe, refined, long-term results—so you can feel confident,
empowered, and more like yourself.

## Personalized Care. Natural Results. 

## Long-Term Confidence.

Here at Damn Girl! Aesthetics and Wellness, we know that when you feel and look good, there’s
nothing stopping you!


Nestled in the heart of San Antonio, Texas, our boutique MedSpa creates personalized aesthetic and
wellness treatments to make you feel and look revitalized, radiant and confident. As a small
practice, we take pride in providing all of our patients with undivided attention and expertise in a
safe, relaxing and comfortable environment.


Your treatment plan should be as individual as you are. From the moment you walk through our doors,
we take the time to understand your goals, your concerns, and the bigger picture of your health and
confidence.


Together, we create a personalized plan designed to support your skin, body, and wellness from the
inside out. Our goal is never to change who you are. It’s to help you look refreshed, feel
empowered, and age with confidence and strength.

aesthetic treatments with whole-person wellness support. We focus on education, safety,
natural-looking outcomes, and meaningful relationships—because we want to be more than a place you
visit for a treatment.

We want to be your trusted partner in feeling confident, supported, and well for years to come.

## Company Introduction

Founded in 2010 and strategically located in Huadu, Guangzhou, near major transport hubs, Guangzhou
Danye Optical Co., Ltd. is a trusted manufacturer of beauty and medical machines with more than 16
years’ experience. We produce over 50+ types of high-quality equipment for both commercial and home
use, supported by a skilled engineering team, efficient sales service, and competitive pricing. Our
machines are widely praised for their effectiveness and durability, earning trust from business
partners worldwide.
Specializing in innovation and customization, Danye offers OEM/ODM services, tailored solutions, and

brands, providing advanced solutions under our motto: "Quality First, Service First."

that can only be performed at medical facilities. It is a gentle method for use at home, and the
results will be noticeable after just a few sessions.

## Official US Source for Authentic Dr. Pen™ Products

Dr. Pen is dedicated to provide top-quality microneedling devices to help you achieve professional
skincare results at home. As the official US distributor, we guarantee the authenticity and safety
of all our products.

**Microneedling: what skin problems will Dr. Pen help you solve?**

Microneedling pen can solve a whole range of problems:
* Dullness, loss of skin even tone and texture.
* Small acne scars, stretch marks.
* Hyperpigmentation or dark spots.
* Flabbiness.
* Wrinkles around the mouth, eyes, and between the eyebrows.

**Benefits of Dr. Pen Microneedling**

Dr. Pen Micro Needling device is far superior to the usual dermarollers. It is distinguished by
outstanding features:
* Customizable. With Dr Pen, you have the power to customize your treatment. Adjust the speed and
  depth of needle penetration to suit different areas of your face and body or to cater to your
  sensitivity levels.
* Delicacy. No bruises or visible damage!
* Simplicity. Any area that needs help can be treated.
* Availability. You do not need a medical background to use a derma pen.
* Efficiency. Results appear quickly and are long-lasting.

## ***The importance of following safety and aftercare rules***

The experience of using Doctor Pen will be favorable if you provide your skin with proper care:
* 3-5 days before the procedure, stop taking anti-inflammatory drugs and fish oil that can stimulate
  bleeding and do not use cosmetics containing vitamin A (retinol).
* Before the procedure, clean, dry, and treat the skin with antiseptic (Chlorhexidine, medical
  alcohol).
* Use anesthetic (numbing) cream 20 minutes before the procedure.

Avoid this procedure if you have active acne or rosacea or are pregnant.

## **What is Dr. Pen™ Microneedling?**

In our youth, our skin itself naturally produces collagen and elastin in sufficient quantities,
maintaining smoothness, elasticity and silkiness. However, with age, these processes slow down, and
it is difficult to spur them on from the outside, because even the most expensive serum cannot
penetrate into the deep layers of the skin. Its molecules are too big!

What does a derma pen do? Microneedles penetrate the top layer of the skin, creating micro-channels,
thanks to which the cells in its depth receive the healing substances they need (hyaluronic acid,
EGF and others). At the same time, the device inflicts microtraumas on the skin, which force the
body to mobilize its strength, and starts the self-healing process, returning the face to its former
freshness.

**Prepare**
1. Disinfect your hands thoroughly before starting the procedure.
2. Attach the new cartridge to the Microneedling Pen. Please do not touch the needles with your
   hands; they must be sterile!
3. Set the desired needle penetration depth by turning the rotating dial on the handle to the
   desired division.
4. Apply the serum to the skin area to treat it immediately before the puncture. This will allow the
   device to glide better.
5. Press the skin with your hand and hold it taut while performing the puncture.
6. Be thorough and meticulous in your treatment. Repeat the process for different areas of the face,
   one area at a time, to ensure comprehensive coverage.

**After-care**

Provide your skin with optimal conditions for healing and restoration.

Follow these recommendations:
1. Avoid swimming for the next 24 hours. Also, sports and other types of physical activity should be
   avoided, which can cause sweating and introduce harmful bacteria into the micro-channels.
2. Exclude products containing vitamins A and C and alpha and beta hydroxy acids from your usual
   beauty rituals for seven days. They are too active and can irritate injured skin.
3. Avoid frequent exposure to direct sunlight and apply cream with UV filters before going outside.
   This advice is best followed on an ongoing basis.

## ***The importance of following safety and aftercare rules***

The experience of using Doctor Pen will be favorable if you provide your skin with proper care:
* 3-5 days before the procedure, stop taking anti-inflammatory drugs and fish oil that can stimulate
  bleeding and do not use cosmetics containing vitamin A (retinol).
* Before the procedure, clean, dry, and treat the skin with antiseptic (Chlorhexidine, medical
  alcohol).
* Use anesthetic (numbing) cream 20 minutes before the procedure.

Avoid this procedure if you have active acne or rosacea or are pregnant.

## **What is Dr. Pen™ Microneedling?**

In our youth, our skin itself naturally produces collagen and elastin in sufficient quantities,
maintaining smoothness, elasticity and silkiness. However, with age, these processes slow down, and
it is difficult to spur them on from the outside, because even the most expensive serum cannot
penetrate into the deep layers of the skin. Its molecules are too big!

What does a derma pen do? Microneedles penetrate the top layer of the skin, creating micro-channels,
thanks to which the cells in its depth receive the healing substances they need (hyaluronic acid,
EGF and others). At the same time, the device inflicts microtraumas on the skin, which force the
body to mobilize its strength, and starts the self-healing process, returning the face to its former
freshness.

**Prepare**
1. Disinfect your hands thoroughly before starting the procedure.
2. Attach the new cartridge to the Microneedling Pen. Please do not touch the needles with your
   hands; they must be sterile!
3. Set the desired needle penetration depth by turning the rotating dial on the handle to the
   desired division.
4. Apply the serum to the skin area to treat it immediately before the puncture. This will allow the
   device to glide better.
5. Press the skin with your hand and hold it taut while performing the puncture.
6. Be thorough and meticulous in your treatment. Repeat the process for different areas of the face,
   one area at a time, to ensure comprehensive coverage.

**After-care**

Provide your skin with optimal conditions for healing and restoration.

Follow these recommendations:
1. Avoid swimming for the next 24 hours. Also, sports and other types of physical activity should be
   avoided, which can cause sweating and introduce harmful bacteria into the micro-channels.
2. Exclude products containing vitamins A and C and alpha and beta hydroxy acids from your usual
   beauty rituals for seven days. They are too active and can irritate injured skin.
3. Avoid frequent exposure to direct sunlight and apply cream with UV filters before going outside.
   This advice is best followed on an ongoing basis.

## FAQ

### How does microneedling work?

Each Dr.Pen device has a cartridge with tiny needles attached. When you turn your device on and
place it the area you wish to treat, the cartridge needles will pulsate and glide along the skin to
penetrate the upper layers of your skin to create deliberate trauma and micro-wounds. These wounds
trigger a healing response from the body, which responds by producing collagen and elastin fibers.
Over time, the skin becomes rejuvenated and reduces the appearance of fine lines, scarring,
hyperpigmentation, loose skin and will brighten and improve your overall texture and tone.

### The main benefits of Dr. Pen microneedling
* Signs of aging
* Scars, such as acne, surgical or other textural irregularities
* Stretch marks
* Fine lines and wrinkles
* Hair loss and Alopecia
* Enlarged pores
* Hyperpigmentation and Melasma
* Sun damage
* Rosacea
* Uneven skin tone
* Loose skin
* Dull/dehydrated skin

### Is Microneedling Painful?

While microneedling can cause mild discomfort, most users find it tolerable. Applying a numbing
cream beforehand can help minimize any pain.


### How Often Should I Use Dr. Pen?

For best results, it’s recommended to use the Dr. Pen once every 4-6 weeks. This allows your skin
time to heal and regenerate between sessions.

### Can I Use Dr. Pen on Sensitive Skin?

Yes! The Dr. Pen is safe for sensitive skin, but be sure to adjust the needle

### How long can i start seeing results? 

Our customers start seeing results in a few days - most see drastically visible results and
differences around 2-3 weeks. Please follow the instructions on your device product page for
specific usage directions. It is important to note that consistency is key with all our devices and
you will see the biggest change after using them for 60 days.

### When is the best time to do micro-infusion?

We suggest performing the treatment in the evening before bedtime. It is advisable to refrain from
sun exposure and makeup application for the following 24 hours post-treatment

### How does microneedling work?

Each Dr.Pen device has a cartridge with tiny needles attached. When you turn your device on and
place it the area you wish to treat, the cartridge needles will pulsate and glide along the skin to
penetrate the upper layers of your skin to create deliberate trauma and micro-wounds. These wounds
trigger a healing response from the body, which responds by producing collagen and elastin fibers.
Over time, the skin becomes rejuvenated and reduces the appearance of fine lines, scarring,
hyperpigmentation, loose skin and will brighten and improve your overall texture and tone.

### The main benefits of Dr. Pen microneedling
* Signs of aging
* Scars, such as acne, surgical or other textural irregularities

* Fine lines and wrinkles
* Hair loss and Alopecia
* Enlarged pores
* Hyperpigmentation and Melasma
* Sun damage
* Rosacea
* Uneven skin tone
* Loose skin
* Dull/dehydrated skin

## Multi-column

### What is Dr. Pen™ Microneedling?

Doctor Pen derma pen is designed for microneedling, the gentle procedure of making multiple
injections with thin needles into the upper layers of the epidermis. This home procedure provokes
the essential skin renewal and ensures that the serum is absorbed. As a result, you get the radiant
and glowing skin.

### Microneedling: what skin problems will Dr. Pen help to solve?

As we age, we may notice that our skin becomes duller. The reason is that the skin's natural
collagen and elastin production processes slow down. We buy expensive serums - but do they work?
Serum molecules are usually too large to penetrate the deep layers of the skin and produce an
effect. Microneedling solves this problem: with small, painless injections, it affects the deep
layers of the skin - and radiance and youth will not take long to appear!

## 100% Authentic and Safe Dr. Pen

We are the official Dr. Pen distributor in the USA and provide you with the authentic Dr. Pen micro
needling device so you can be sure you use the original and safe product.

### Effect and Benefits of Dr. Pen Microneedling

Use Dr. Penprofessional microneedling pen to:
* Return of freshskincolor and glow
* Promote skin shedding
* Remove stratum corneum
* Even out the skin
* Make the skin look and feel smoother

### Take the Most from Dr. Pen for Your Beautiful Skin

Dr. Pen micro needling device has multiple benefits:
* It’s adjusted to your needs. You can choose the treatment that your skin is really need. Do you
  want to penetrate the deep layers to make the skin more glowing? Choose your right depth of the
  needle penetration. Do you have sensitive skin? Customize your Dr. Pen to forget about painful
  procedures!
* It’s smooth. Thin needles do not damage the skin, do not leave bruises or visible damage.
* It’s ready to use. Our derma pen is ready to use immediately upon delivery. Simply follow the
  instructions, prepare the skin and use Dr. Pen on any part of the face that needs treatment.
* It’s easy-to-use. You can use Doctor Pen in your bathroom - no special knowledge or medical
  background is needed.
* It’s efficient. It doesn’t take a lot of time to see the result that will last longer.

## Our customers review

### The Safety Rules and Aftercare

Take care of your skin and follow these safety guidelines to ensure the best and safest
microneedling experience:
* 3-5 days before the microneedling procedure: Stop taking anti-inflammatory drugs, fish oil and
  avoid vitamin A (retinol) in your skin care routine.
* The same day: Clean the skin with the antiseptic (Chlorhexidine, medical alcohol).
* 20 min before: Apply the numbing cream to minimize the pain.

Be careful: If you have active skin problem or if you are pregnant, it’s better to postpone the
procedure.

## Multi-column

### What is Dr. Pen™ Microneedling?

Doctor Pen derma pen is designed for microneedling, the gentle procedure of making multiple
injections with thin needles into the upper layers of the epidermis. This home procedure provokes
the essential skin renewal and ensures that the serum is absorbed. As a result, you get the radiant
and glowing skin.

### Microneedling: what skin problems will Dr. Pen help to solve?

As we age, we may notice that our skin becomes duller. The reason is that the skin's natural
collagen and elastin production processes slow down. We buy expensive serums - but do they work?
Serum molecules are usually too large to penetrate the deep layers of the skin and produce an
effect. Microneedling solves this problem: with small, painless injections, it affects the deep
layers of the skin - and radiance and youth will not take long to appear!

## 100% Authentic and Safe Dr. Pen

We are the official Dr. Pen distributor in the USA and provide you with the authentic Dr. Pen micro
needling device so you can be sure you use the original and safe product.

### Effect and Benefits of Dr. Pen Microneedling

Use Dr. Penprofessional microneedling pen to:
* Return of freshskincolor and glow
* Promote skin shedding
* Remove stratum corneum
* Even out the skin
* Make the skin look and feel smoother

### Take the Most from Dr. Pen for Your Beautiful Skin

Dr. Pen micro needling device has multiple benefits:
* It’s adjusted to your needs. You can choose the treatment that your skin is really need. Do you
  want to penetrate the deep layers to make the skin more glowing? Choose your right depth of the
  needle penetration. Do you have sensitive skin? Customize your Dr. Pen to forget about painful
  procedures!
* It’s smooth. Thin needles do not damage the skin, do not leave bruises or visible damage.
* It’s ready to use. Our derma pen is ready to use immediately upon delivery. Simply follow the
  instructions, prepare the skin and use Dr. Pen on any part of the face that needs treatment.
* It’s easy-to-use. You can use Doctor Pen in your bathroom - no special knowledge or medical
  background is needed.
* It’s efficient. It doesn’t take a lot of time to see the result that will last longer.

## Our customers review

### The Safety Rules and Aftercare

Take care of your skin and follow these safety guidelines to ensure the best and safest
microneedling experience:
* 3-5 days before the microneedling procedure: Stop taking anti-inflammatory drugs, fish oil and
  avoid vitamin A (retinol) in your skin care routine.
* The same day: Clean the skin with the antiseptic (Chlorhexidine, medical alcohol).
* 20 min before: Apply the numbing cream to minimize the pain.

Be careful: If you have active skin problem or if you are pregnant, it’s better to postpone the
procedure.

NEW ON EVERY ARTICLE

## Every Compound Gets A Verdict

Every article now opens with a BLUF—Bottom Line Up Front. A plain-English editorial verdict you can
read in five seconds, color-coded by confidence level, before you commit to the full article.

Four verdict categories. Stoplight colors. No hedging.

STRONG FOUNDATION
FDA-approved or equivalent controlled trial evidence
REASONABLE BET
Plausible mechanism, coherent rationale, not yet proven
EYES OPEN
Interesting but significant gaps. Know what you don’t know
THIN ICE
Hype has outrun the evidence. Proceed carefully
BLUF: BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT
REASONABLE BET
Strong animal data, almost no human trials
[BPC-157][176] is a synthetic peptide fragment studied mostly in rats for injury repair—tendons,
muscles, gut lining, and bone. The animal research is unusually large for a peptide this early in
development. But only three small human studies exist, none of them controlled trials. If you’re
considering it, you should know: the evidence is promising but almost entirely from rodents, and no
one has mapped its long-term safety in people.

table, an honest assessment of where the human data ends, and the safety picture as it actually
stands.

NEW ON EVERY ARTICLE

## Every Compound Gets A Verdict

Every article now opens with a BLUF—Bottom Line Up Front. A plain-English editorial verdict you can
read in five seconds, color-coded by confidence level, before you commit to the full article.

Four verdict categories. Stoplight colors. No hedging.

STRONG FOUNDATION
FDA-approved or equivalent controlled trial evidence
REASONABLE BET
Plausible mechanism, coherent rationale, not yet proven
EYES OPEN
Interesting but significant gaps. Know what you don’t know
THIN ICE
Hype has outrun the evidence. Proceed carefully
BLUF: BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT
REASONABLE BET
Strong animal data, almost no human trials
[BPC-157][176] is a synthetic peptide fragment studied mostly in rats for injury repair—tendons,
muscles, gut lining, and bone. The animal research is unusually large for a peptide this early in
development. But only three small human studies exist, none of them controlled trials. If you’re
considering it, you should know: the evidence is promising but almost entirely from rodents, and no
one has mapped its long-term safety in people.

# Just Find Skin Care That Works For You

Welcome to The Skincare Company Spa & Salon. We are a Full Service Spa and Hair Salon located in the
River Forest, Forest Park, Oak Park IL area. We are located within 5-15 minutes of the following
locations: Chicago, Melrose Park, Elmwood Park, Brookfield IL, Riverside, La Grange IL and Berwyn.
Our friendly staff is fully trained, licensed and certified to give you the best in clinical skin
care and spa treatments.
* We offer Advanced Clinical Skincare treatments designed to target and address a variety of skin
  concerns, including anti-aging, hyperpigmentation, acne, and more.
* Advanced, clinical skin care with a friendly staff is fully trained, licensed and certified to
  give you the best in clinical skin care and spa treatments.
* Treatments include advanced procedures such as chemical peels, microneedling, and customized
  facials tailored to your specific skin needs.
* We combine science-backed ingredients and techniques to enhance skin health while focusing on
  improving texture, tone, and overall radiance.

# SQT Bio-microneedling USA Beauty

We understand the complexities of navigating today’s aesthetic industry—a world of unmet promises,
the daily challenge of matching treatments to problematic skin, and the extensive list of
contraindications for specific Fitzpatrick skin types.
* No Needles
* No Devices
* No Chemicals
* No Acids
* No Skin Breakage

## Over a Decade of Research & Development 21 Patents for Innovation in 80 Countries

## Primary Advantages of SQT® treatments

Unlock the transformative potential of radiant, life-changing skin for your clients
* 100% Natural Safe Ingredients
* Effective for Various Skin Concerns
* No Skin Breakage or Risk of Infection
* Free from Harsh Chemicals, Fragrances, Alcohol and Acids
* Suitable for all Fitzpatrick Skin Types
* Minimal Downtime: 4-7 Days
* No Devices or Machines Required
* Versatile Treatment
* Needle-Free Application
* Can be used on all body areas

## Enhance Your Skills and Services!

Unlock the potential of SQT® Biomicroneedling and bring cutting-edge skin rejuvenation to your
clients. Enroll in our comprehensive training program today!

[ Start Training ][30]

## SQT® Bio-microneedling is a safe and low-risk treatment that consistently delivers outstanding
## results for a variety of skin conditions.

Addresses wide range of skin concerns
* Wrinkles and Fine Lines
* Hyperpigmentation
* Enlarged Pores
* Aging Skin
* Sagging Skin
* Dull Skin
* Hydrolipid barrier function
* Increase epidermal thickness
* Active acne and scarring
* Sun Damage
* Uneven Skin Texture and Tone
* Stretch Marks
* Superficial Scars
* Comedones and Clogged Pores
* Exfoliation
* Collagen production

## Stand out with SQT®….

Get certified and receive products to kick-off SQT treatments immediately. By reselling these
high-demand treatments, you not only recover your investment but also stand to gain a profit, making
your training virtually cost-neutral.

### Gain a Competitive Edge

Staying current is essential for maintaining a client-focused approach. Distinguish your clinic with
a treatment that is at the forefront of innovative dermal technology.

### Build Clientele Through Trust and Loyalty

With SQT®, your clients will experience transformative skin treatments that not only secure their
loyalty but also turn them into advocates for your clinic. They’ll showcase the visible improvements
in their rejuvenated skin.

### Increase Your Profit

Leverage SQT®’s efficient and effective solutions to offer high-demand treatments, boosting your
revenue without incurring significant overhead costs.

### Reduce Treatment Length by 50-70%

Compared to other treatment methods, SQT® BioMicroneedling offers a straightforward application
process, giving you more time to focus on growing your business.

## Research Facts about SQT®

### Skin Penetration

The spicules used in SQT® penetrate the skin 20-30% deeper than traditional microneedling devices,
enhancing the delivery of active ingredients

### Effectiveness

A single session of SQT® Bio Microneedling can achieve results equivalent to 60-80% of three to five
traditional microneedling sessions.

### Natural and Safe

Since the spicules are extracted from natural freshwater sponges, the treatment is 100% natural and
safe for all skin types.

## Become a Certified Expert!

Stand out in the skincare industry by becoming a certified SQT® Biomicroneedling expert. Register
for our training course and elevate your professional skills.

[ Get Certified ][31]

## Getting Started is Easy

Our streamlined four-step certification process can be completed in as little as one week.

#### 1

### Purchase Your Starter Kit

Kick off your SQT® journey with our Starter Kit, complete with essential products and resources to
lay the foundation for your training.

#### 2

### Complete Your Training

Engage in comprehensive training that combines both theory and practical skills, enabling you to
master the art of SQT® BioMicroneedling treatments.

#### 3

### Become a Certified Provider

Upon completing your training, achieve official SQT® provider status and join an elite group of
skincare professionals.

#### 4

### Sit Back and Grow

Enhance your clinic’s offerings with SQT® treatments, attracting a broader client base and expanding
your service portfolio.

# Your Guide to Safe, Proven Aesthetic Care

At World’s Leading Clinics, we connect discerning patients with certified providers who combine
artistry, advanced skill, and uncompromising care, delivering results that inspire confidence and
natural beauty. A global standard patients can trust, and clinics aspire to achieve.

What we do

## Overview & Patient Benefits

Every treatment by a World’s Leading Clinics Certified Provider is delivered with advanced
techniques, world-class technology, and uncompromising safety standards. From surgical procedures
performed by board-certified surgeons to non-surgical treatments by certified aesthetic specialists,
every service is personalized to your goals. Compare top providers, explore verified results, and
make confident choices guided by our trusted experts.

[ See All Clinics ][16]

### Transparency

We make your search effortless by showing exactly how each clinic meets our standards. Every
certified clinic lists verified credentials, treatment offerings, and patient feedback, so you can
compare options and choose a provider based on facts, not marketing.

### Integrity over Influence

We are not (and will never be!) pay-to-play. Unlike our competition, clinics cannot buy recognition
or placement on our platform. Every certification is earned through a transparent, evidence-based
evaluation measuring safety, ethics, and patient outcomes. Recognition is a privilege, not a
purchase.

### Independent Evaluation

Our certification process is independent. Clinics undergo in-depth reviews across safety, outcomes,
culture, and patient experience, ensuring only those that meet the world’s highest standards are
recognized.

### Education at the Core

Knowledge empowers confidence. That’s why we created an entire educational library on our site,
featuring treatment guides, concern-based topics, and personal blog posts with expert insights and
videos. It’s designed to help you understand your options, learn from trusted providers, and make
informed decisions about your care.

### Credibility

Our network features board-certified surgeons, physicians, and licensed specialists with verified
training and proven results. Whether you’re exploring plastic surgery or non-surgical rejuvenation,
you can trust your care to experienced professionals known for excellence and natural outcomes.

### Global Standards, Local Excellence

Every clinic in our network is evaluated through the same transparent criteria, ensuring consistent
quality no matter where you are. Whether you’re in Los Angeles or London, you can expect the same
standard of expertise, ethics, and patient-first care.

### You First, Always

Your safety, comfort, and confidence are our top priorities. Each certified clinic upholds the
highest medical and ethical standards, providing care with precision, discretion, and compassion -
the defining traits of the world’s leading practices.

## Top Treatments

Every treatment by a World’s Leading Clinics Certified Provider is delivered with advanced
techniques, world-class technology, and uncompromising safety standards. Surgical procedures are
performed by board-certified plastic surgeons and board-certified surgeons in their respective
specialties, while non-surgical treatments are delivered by certified aesthetic specialists. From
facelifts and breast enhancement to injectables, laser therapies, and skin rejuvenation, each

natural facial features against a soft, neutral background.] ][33]

### [Botox][34]

Botox is a precision-administered injectable that softens fine lines and wrinkles by relaxing
targeted facial muscles. Trusted by millions worldwide, it delivers a refreshed, youthful appearance
with minimal downtime, and results that typically last three to four months.

[ View Procedure ][35]

treatment.] ][36]

### [Biostimulators / Collagen Stimulators][37]

Collagen stimulators like Sculptra and Radiesse restore subtle volume, improve skin quality, and
refresh facial contours with gradual, natural-looking results.

[ View Procedure ][38]
[ [Woman in white underwear highlighting toned abdomen and waistline.] ][39]

### [Liposuction][40]

Liposuction removes targeted fat deposits with precision to sculpt and redefine body contours. This
highly effective surgical procedure offers dramatic, long-lasting improvements, with a recovery plan
tailored to your lifestyle and comfort.

[ View Procedure ][41]

### [Breast Augmentation][42]

Breast augmentation enhances the size, shape, and symmetry of the breasts using the latest implant
technology or advanced fat transfer techniques. Each procedure is customized for balance,
proportion, and naturally beautiful results.

[ View Procedure ][43]
[ [Woman with smooth, radiant skin posing against a light background] ][44]

### [HydraFacial][45]

HydraFacial is a multi-step, non-invasive facial treatment that deeply cleanses, exfoliates, and
hydrates in one session. Suitable for all skin types, HydraFacial instantly improves skin tone,
texture, and radiance while promoting long-term skin health—delivering a refreshed glow with zero
downtime.
